title: cairn test and the tester's --exec site have a bash-free entry on Windows
intention: On Windows a proof can run cairn test and a plain --exec command without bash, so it runs prevent-kind at Low integrity; detect-kind runs that spawn bash shrink toward zero.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akienyoga9i at windows-instance-seal bac87fc50: 201 of 683 proofs read detect-kind by static scan (135 on a bare bin/cairn mention only); --exec spawns bash at cli.py:489 and device.py:1097; three --exec proofs are red on Windows on main ebd31727f, each from a Windows path inside a bash-language string. MSYS bash cannot start at Low (56b61c10bdbe D8), so every bash driver is a detect-kind run.
traces_to: Law 4 (the seal is physics: prevent beats detect), Law 3.
how: D1 the tester publishes cairn_test_argv(*args) -> (argv, env, cwd): POSIX [bin/cairn, test, *args]; Windows [sys.executable, -m, cairn.devices.tester.cli, *args], cwd REPO, CAIRN_TESTER_CALLER_CWD, PYTHONUTF8=1. D2 Windows --exec runs a metacharacter-free command as a non-POSIX shlex argv, prevent-kind; otherwise bash -c, detect, why 'command needs a shell'. D3 a detect record carries bash_spawned from the reach spawn log; a bare bin/cairn mention no longer makes a proof detect. D4 the tester's own proofs that run bin/cairn test move to cairn_test_argv. Windows bounded lists only; Linux seals on the Dell.

outcomes.claim: a tester proof using base's cairn_test_argv (child ticket a29cf5216236) runs prevent-kind and green at Low
a plain --exec '<python> -c ...' on Windows records seal_kind prevent, spawns no bash, and passes its exit code and stdout through; a command with | records detect and the why 'command needs a shell'
a Windows backslashed path in a plain --exec command reaches the process intact; no C:Users... debris
a detect-kind record carries bash_spawned true/false, and a bare bin/cairn mention in a proof's text alone does not make it detect
the three --exec proofs are green on Windows in a bounded run, or each remaining red has its own ticket with its measurement
